component: context_refiner.0 query geometry and q16 export candidate
scope: Exact invocation-7 and invocation-8 context_refiner.0 captures, MPS SDPA geometry replay, full CPU ORT prediction gates, and Chrome WebGPU teacher-forced replay.

mpsGeometry.interpretation: MPS has a query-geometry threshold at 16 for the retained rows, and non-retained query contents do not affect them. The canonical exporter already uses 256-query chunks, so it is already above this threshold.

q16Candidate.change: Only context_refiner.0 uses 16-query functional SDPA chunks. The final partial chunk is padded with a repeated live row and padding outputs are discarded.

cpuOrtVersusUntouchedOfficial.comparisonToCanonical: Both full-prediction metric sets are identical to the canonical CPU ORT reports.

chromeWebgpuGraphOptimizationAll.comparisonToCanonicalOptimizationAll: Invocation 7 and invocation 8 metrics are exactly identical to the canonical graphOptimizationLevel=all report.

decision.reason: The canonical 256-query chunks already reproduce the measured full-query MPS geometry. Q16 increases graph size, leaves CPU ORT unchanged, and is an exact numerical no-op under optimized WebGPU while invocation 8 still fails.
